strings: In misery, m_c slinks into r_c0's den, head down and wincing from the rattling pain in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head.
When m_c woke up this morning, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} decided to just roll back over and squeeze {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes shut in the hopes of avoiding the splitting pain.
m_c lies in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest, clutching {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head in pain.
